vision.name: Android 19's Draining Grasp
vision.text:
[Defense] Stops a physical attack.
Your opponent loses 4 stages. Search your Life Deck for a card with "Android" in the title and place it into your hand. Attach to your MP. While attached, you may banish this card to cancel the immediate effects of a physical attack.
vision.note: Organized Play card (OP5 folder); grey card; possessive title -> Named; no Endurance badge
